score_rationale: The agent CORE LOOP is genuinely production-grade (8.5/10 in isolation): TOCTOU-safe shared-atomic budget, race-clean iter.Seq2 with airtight yield-after-false discipline, two-tier dedup with progress veto, real circuit breaker checked before each call, bounded per-call/per-tool timeouts, untrusted-output provenance envelope (NFKC + HTML-escape + crypto/rand nonce), capped subprocess buffers, symlink-resistant workspace fences. The 2026-06-10/11 P0/P1 remediation is REAL work, not paperwork — most prior closures verify. The score is held down by the PRODUCTION PERIMETER, which this re-audit finds materially weaker than the prior cycle credited: (a) crash-durability gap — mutating tool side effects re-execute after an intra-turn crash (R-05 only half-closed); (b) the serve daemon never boots the tracer and the agent core has no structured logging and no latency/error/cost metrics, so production runs operationally BLIND; (c) no per-thread in-flight guard — concurrent runs on one thread corrupt conversation history; (d) a new trust-boundary hole — swarm child reports re-enter the parent prompt unwrapped; (e) no production container (non-root, resource-bounded) for a runtime that executes arbitrary shell. Core 8.5, perimeter ~4.5 → blended 6.5. Closing the P1 set lands 7.5-8.
